question: Using the bigquery-public-data.open_images dataset, can you provide a count of how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'cat' (where the image has label '/m/01yrx' with confidence=1) and how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'other' (meaning they have no cat label '/m/01yrx' at all)?
sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_conf1.image_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cat_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l_any.image_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as other_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images`
) all_images
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` 
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx' AND confidence = 1.0
) l_conf1 ON all_images.image_id = l_conf1.image_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` 
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx'
) l_any ON all_images.image_id = l_any.image_id
